title: Bringing powerful AI to millions across Europe with Deutsche Telekom
description: OpenAI is collaborating with Deutsche Telekom to bring advanced, multilingual AI experiences to millions of people across Europe. ChatGPT Enterprise will also be deployed to help employees at Deutsche Telekom improve workflows and accelerate innovation.
author: Desconocido

title: Building AI fluency at scale with ChatGPT Enterprise
description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia partners with OpenAI to roll out ChatGPT Enterprise to 50,000 employees, building AI fluency at scale to improve customer service and fraud response.
author: Desconocido

title: Instacart and OpenAI partner on AI shopping experiences
description: OpenAI and Instacart are deepening their longstanding partnership by bringing the first fully integrated grocery shopping and Instant Checkout payment app to ChatGPT.
author: Desconocido

title: The state of enterprise AI
description: Key findings from OpenAI’s enterprise data show accelerating AI adoption, deeper integration, and measurable productivity gains across industries in 2025.
author: Desconocido

title: How Virgin Atlantic uses AI to enhance every step of travel
description: Virgin Atlantic CFO Oliver Byers shares how the airline is using AI to speed up development, improve decision-making, and elevate customer experience.
author: Desconocido

title: Introducing OpenAI for Australia
description: OpenAI is launching OpenAI for Australia to build sovereign AI infrastructure, upskill more than 1.5 million workers, and accelerate innovation across the country’s growing AI ecosystem.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI to acquire Neptune
description: OpenAI is acquiring Neptune to deepen visibility into model behavior and strengthen the tools researchers use to track experiments and monitor training.
author: Desconocido

title: How confessions can keep language models honest
description: OpenAI researchers are testing “confessions,” a method that trains models to admit when they make mistakes or act undesirably, helping improve AI honesty, transparency, and trust in model outputs.
author: Desconocido

title: Announcing the initial People-First AI Fund grantees
description: The OpenAI Foundation announces the initial recipients of the People-First AI Fund, awarding $40.5M in unrestricted grants to 208 nonprofits supporting community innovation and opportunity.
author: Desconocido

title: Inside Mirakl’s Agent Commerce Vision
description: Mirakl is redefining commerce through AI agents and ChatGPT Enterprise—achieving faster documentation, smarter customer support, and building toward agent-native commerce with Mirakl Nexus.
author: Desconocido

title: Funding grants for new research into AI and mental health
description: OpenAI is awarding up to $2 million in grants for research at the intersection of AI and mental health. The program supports projects that study real-world risks, benefits, and applications to improve safety and well-being.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI and NORAD team up to bring new magic to “NORAD Tracks Santa”
description: OpenAI and NORAD are bringing new magic to “NORAD Tracks Santa” with three ChatGPT holiday tools that let families create festive elves, toy coloring pages, and custom Christmas stories.
author: Desconocido

title: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption
description: OpenAI takes an ownership stake in Thrive Holdings to accelerate enterprise AI adoption, embedding frontier research and engineering directly into accounting and IT services to boost speed, accuracy, and efficiency while creating a scalable model for industry-wide transformation.
author: Desconocido

title: Accenture and OpenAI accelerate enterprise AI success
description: Accenture is rolling out 40,000 ChatGPT Enterprise licenses and naming OpenAI its primary intelligence partner to power enterprise AI success, upskill teams, and deliver AI-driven client outcomes.
author: Desconocido
